name: the rest length fitted to one scan against the measured internuclear distance of H2's ground state

reference.ref: NIST Chemistry WebBook, H2, Constants of diatomic molecules, the row X 1Σg+, r_e in angstrom (mat-20261120-nist-webbook-h2-diatomic-constants)

held.reason: the reference states no uncertainty, and no published values of H2's bond length with the same functional were taken as materials, so the person's standing rule gives no span; its last branch would judge a PBE bond length by half the last digit NIST prints, which a PBE value is not expected to meet
